title: Research: exact fixed-slot optimum for selective helper470 retirement
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Research note and conditional cost certificate; no new bit endpoint, kappa or supplier admission.** PR1256 provides a rank-seven helper470 endpoint and a favorable two-slot relaxation, leaving timing open. In the frozen PR589 allocation, only stages **2, 4 and 6** can use the existing rank-seven idle windows. This package gives their explicit placements and proves the exact optimum in the stated fixed-slot model. Requiring retirement in all nine stages costs more.

The declared class fixes the recipe and every other helper's placement. A converted helper can shrink in place or use contiguous cells that were originally idle. Joint use of the nine empty rank-42 children is included; newly freed holes are excluded. All returned and consumed rank is charged. The selective profile preserves 904,896 children and rank mass 1,808,352 and lowers the inherited complete bill by approximately 3.0483817628e-7 at the existing exponent. This is not a new supplier bound or a scalar-operation saving.

H4/reverse physical routing, mixed-width pending projectors, complete-call realization, a stage-indexed emitter, the new native/hosted stream, precision/tape and all-size/analytic obligations remain open. The current emitter's orientation-only dispatch does not already implement the proposed mixture.

## Task and overlap

OS assignment seed **14**, bit supplier. Base `410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983`; contribution `20c668d2bab32faa45401ce07c575025b761f52e`. Upstream refresh `e6f9716621f4e01fc190617934cdfaf072bd976f` retains all ten source/provenance blobs unchanged. The selected conditional kappa remains `836330098538459/500000000000000000` and complex-bound.

Only `research/bit-helper470-window-placement-seed14/` is added. TASK.json records the deliberate change from the already covered H2/K card to this H4/hosting component; CLAIM.json records three candidates and the local claim, because no pinned coordination issue existed.

Nearest work: PR1256 `d6d5a994fcdcd8d04ec439ff988daa8f37b17ece` owns the endpoint; PR1401 `c4f3e9ae15bfc9c358af79bf023ae046961be499` excludes in-place savings; PR1302 `0cc5db33b0999a7d3333383a855667f6f8cbda88` supplies finite native replay. The new evidence is the timed joint-placement optimum. PR1043's earlier source-boundary deletion and reported hosted invoice are not improved or combined here. PR1307's physical-projector limitation is retained. Discussion1427 varies the recipe with width-eight helpers; this freezes the recipe and changes one residual width.

The final complete overlap snapshot covered 804 open PR records and 168 discussion records at 01:21 UTC, without warnings. Search limits and exact predecessor heads are recorded.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-helper470-window-placement-seed14
```

Expected: `PASS_HELPER470_WINDOW_PLACEMENT`, `PASS_INDEPENDENT_HELPER470_PLACEMENT`, seven tests OK, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Registered CPython 3.12.2 replay passes. The first implementation prices all 2,610 individual relocations and 63 joint rank-42 occupant subsets. A separate implementation enumerates 2,550 optional and 211 mandatory complete profiles without that reduction; both retained exact moment engines check the bills. The credited local patch replays all 661 dirty columns in both scalar directions. Twelve rejection controls and seven tests cover missing gates, stale cleanup, timing, collisions, missing idle charges, source corruption and forged owner evidence.

The primary optimized CPython 3.14.6 replay, metadata/pins, selected baseline bindings, and read-only source-export replay under CPython 3.12.2 `-I -O -B` pass. An orientation probe created one bytecode file that the selected inventory check correctly rejected; it was removed and the check passed, with no source bytes changed. No native/hosted new-dispatch replay, selected cold replay, Lean proof or hosted-CI success is claimed.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json identify the next physical obligation: bind stage 2, child 1, copy 14 to the actual pending projector and a valid H4 replacement, then implement stage-indexed dispatch. A separate extension may allow using newly freed holes, which is outside this optimum. Neither is asserted complete.
